row.team_price_text: $599/month (up to $100k in monthly billings), unlimited users
row.evidence: Maxio's help centre documents Enterprise SSO (Okta, Google Workspace or SAML) that Maxio switches on, while users are created by an admin under Admin > Settings > Users > Add User; no SCIM appears in the help centre (all 1,045 sitemap pages searched) or the API reference.
row.notes: No SCIM by absence (rule 5). Maxio (formerly Chargify and SaaSOptics) prices by billing volume, not seats: Grow $599/month up to $100k monthly billings, Scale Get a Quote; unlimited users at no charge, default agreements paid annually, so per-user fields stay null. Enterprise SSO (Okta, Google Workspace or generic SAML; one connection per account) must be enabled by Maxio, with no plan named, so sso_plan is null. Users are created, edited, deactivated and reactivated manually in Admin > Settings > Users; revoking in the IdP only blocks sign-in. The developer API (Advanced Billing) covers billing objects and has no team-user endpoints. Okta's catalogue app is the legacy Chargify SWA app (2015). The pricing page returns 403 to curl and render.cjs; its quotes were read via WebFetch.

plans.name: Grow
plans.notes: Unlimited users at no additional charge; default agreements paid annually. Flat volume-based price.

plans.name: Scale
plans.price_text: Get a Quote (over $100k in monthly billings)

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint in the pricing page, the docs.maxio.com sitemap (all 1,045 pages fetched and grepped for 'scim': 0 hits) or the developer API index. false is by absence (rule 5).

user_api.notes: The Advanced Billing API covers sites, catalog, subscriptions, customers and invoices; no endpoints for Maxio team users or roles in the llms.txt index. 'Subscription group members' are billing customers, not users. false is by absence.

okta.notes: Legacy 'Chargify' OIN app, last updated 2015; only SWA is checked (read from page markup). Maxio's own docs set up Okta as an OIDC-style Okta connection or a custom SAML 2.0 app.

entra.notes: Not in the Entra saas-apps tutorial TOC. Entra can sign in via Maxio's generic SAML connection type, recorded as sso_only in row.idp.

google.notes: Google Workspace is a built-in Enterprise SSO connection type (client ID and secret); no provisioning.

fallbacks.notes: Users are created by an admin (Add User), which also links their Universal Login account; no JIT creation is documented.
